_comment: FACTORtv — SEASON PRESETS.
A preset is a calendar plus a points system. Copy one, change the
rounds, and it appears in the overlay's New Career list — which is why
calendars live here as data rather than behind a track picker in the
menu: editing JSON is faster and more precise than clicking through 24
circuits with a mouse the game also wants.
`slug` must be a circuit slug that track.py resolves — run
`python track.py` to list them. A round whose slug is unknown is kept
but can never be matched to a live session, so the booth will simply
never mention it.
`open: true` means no fixed calendar: each new circuit you race becomes
the next round. You get 'round six of the season' with no setup, and
lose 'six rounds remaining' and the title maths, because with no end
date neither of those is a true statement.
`points` is scored by finishing position, index 0 = first place. rF2's
own Points field is deliberately ignored: it is only populated inside
rF2's own championships, and on the development machine 89 of 132 races
awarded zero to every driver.
`fastest_lap` awards one extra point for the fastest lap of the race,
F1-style, and only to a driver finishing in the points.
